status.evidence: According to the UK Companies House registry, Camera Telematics (UK) Limited (Company number 10573294) is an active private limited company incorporated on 19 January 2017 with its registered office in Newbury.

claims.claim: Camera Telematics deployed a bespoke video telematics solution for Greenore Port's Liebherr Harbour Mobile Cranes (LHMs), providing real-time dual-camera views over a cloud-based platform to port management.

The company reports that its iC360 hardware system range comes equipped with a standard GPS location module, with optional 4G and Wi-Fi upgrades to enable real-time positioning, live streaming, remote configuration, and instant First Notification of Loss (FNOL) data transfers.

The company reports its "advanced reporting software" handles real-time fleet positioning, route optimization, fuel usage, and driver behavior monitoring, packaged within solutions like the iC360 range.
claims.source: Camera Telematics Website (https://www.camera-telematics.co.uk/commercial-fleet, Slideshare iC360 Presentation https://www.slideshare.net/slideshow/ic360-presentation-79094607/79094607)

claims.claim: Camera Telematics established a joint partnership with Geotab Inc. to make its Street Angel hardware solution available on the Geotab Marketplace, combining its advanced vehicle camera technology with connected transportation systems.
The company reports that it designs advanced multi-camera hardware solutions capable of delivering up to 360-degree vehicle coverage for safety and compliance.

A fleet-wide commercial rollout of the company's proprietary iC360 vehicle camera solution by client Westminster Waste Ltd provided real-time operational footage access for insurance fraud protection.

Camera Telematics established a global partnership with Key Telematics to integrate its advanced onboard camera hardware, 'Street Angel', with Key Telematics' SaaS software platform, which features an application programming interface (API) that provides flexibility for building custom features and integrating third-party solutions, including fuel card data.

Camera Telematics collaborated with Greenore Port to deliver a robust video telematics solution for reviewing incident footage, logging "Camera Learning Opportunities" for crane operators, and managing liability for alleged damage to vessels, cargo, or port equipment.
claims.corrected: Camera Telematics collaborated with Greenore Port to deliver a robust video telematics solution for reviewing incident footage, logging "Camera Learning Opportunities" for crane operators, and managing liability for alleged damage to vessels, cargo, or port machinery.

claims.claim: The company's official corporate registration filing at the UK GOV.UK Companies House registry confirms that Camera Telematics (UK) Limited is an active private limited company incorporated on 19 January 2017 with its registered office in Newbury, Berkshire, under SIC code 47429 (Retail sale of telecommunications equipment other than mobile telephones).

A strategic partnership with Geotab was announced in January 2022 to list Camera Telematics’ "Street Angel" hardware solution on the Geotab Marketplace, allowing integration with Geotab's fleet management systems.

An agreement with software platform provider Key Telematics was announced in May 2019 to integrate the "Street Angel" hardware with Key Telematics' global software ecosystem and expand its reach to global resellers.
claims.source: Reveela, Fleet News, and Fleetpoint publications from May 2019

claims.claim: Perennial Freight adopted Camera Telematics' multi-camera solution across 85 HGVs operating from three locations in the Republic of Ireland with daily services to the UK, as reported by UK Tech News in July 2024.
claims.source: UK Tech News report dated July 3, 2024

claims.claim: Camera Telematics announced a distribution and integration partnership with Key Telematics in May 2019 to host its "Street Angel" onboard camera hardware on Key Telematics' global SaaS platform across 130 countries.
claims.source: Fleet News report dated May 16, 2019 quoting Group MD Mark Stamper regarding operations across 130 countries

claims.claim: Camera Telematics (UK) Limited maintains its active registered corporate office at Consort House, 42 Bone Lane, Newbury, Berkshire, RG14 5RD, as documented by UK Companies House filings.
